title: Jack Sarfatti and physicists gather at Puharich's house
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Jack Sarfatti and physicists gather at Puharich's house, about 1970s at Ossining, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: just all sorts of Sarfattis, Jack Sarfatti being one of them. Like him and his kind of group of physicist people would go up there.

plain: An unnamed researcher on a 2026 episode of podcast host Jesse Michels's show, about a CIA scientist named Andrija Puharich who is said to have contacted an alien council, says that in the 1970s a physicist named Jack Sarfatti and his circle of physicists would go up to Puharich's house in Ossining, New York. The guest tells it to show that serious scientists gathered around Puharich and his claims.
